verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS communications platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk export of account data in open formats, and no number port-out or offboarding path. The REST APIs and Event Streams are building blocks or adjacent features, and porting docs cover only port-in to Twilio. The only on-topic community report (Authy) says Twilio makes exporting data extremely difficult, which supports the absence rather than creating a dispute.
